name: Useful Proof
summary: A compact capability identity that links an offer to a concrete sample and a bounded account of contribution.

typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source used style ProofContact.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source used style ProofContact.

recognitionRules: Lead with the capability in the title, not a long personal introduction.
Use a clear label-name-metadata hierarchy above the proof body.
Keep a single reading column with brief evidence blocks and an explicit next conversation.
Use red category labels, evidence numbers and invitation cues against black reading text on white; preserve the left number gutter.

principles: Name the work and the contribution before describing personal qualities.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Here is the work I can do, and a sample you can inspect.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid unsupported expertise labels and turning prototypes into shipped outcomes.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: I made this part; the team decided what happened next.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use USEFUL PROOF as a plain Arial wordmark with one short baseline rule. No icon or score seal.
invariants: Lead with the capability in the title, not a long personal introduction.
Use a clear label-name-metadata hierarchy above the proof body.
Keep a single reading column with brief evidence blocks and an explicit next conversation.
adaptations: For a different audience change the capability statement and sample together.
Keep the sheet to one coherent offer.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.
